product.description: HUGH JOHNSON a fost liderul scriitorilor despre vinuri și le-a oferit multe direcţii noi în cei 48 de ani scurși de la publicarea primei lui cărţi, Wine. The World Atlas of Wine, Wine Companion, Pocket Wine Book (publicat anual din 1977, cel mai vândut anuar despre vinuri), The Story of Wine și cartea de memorii A Life Uncorked au fost bestselleruri. Abordarea lui unică, serioasă și informată i-a adus admiraţia iubitorilor de vinuri. Pasionat și de grădinărit, în 2011 a câștigat premiul Garden Media Guild’s Reference Book of the Year pentru Trees: A Lifetime Journey. Vânzările cărţilor sale au depășit 16 milioane de exemplare. În 2003, a fost făcut Chevalier al Ordre National du Mérite de către președintele Chirac, iar în 2007 i s-a acordat Ordinul Imperiului Britanic pentru servicii aduse vinificaţiei și horticulturii.   JANCIS ROBINSON are o solidă reputaţie internaţională. Cărţile sale, printre care Oxford Companion to Wine (1994, 1999, 2006) și Wine Grapes (2012), sunt lucrări de referinţă multipremiate. Este corespondent pentru vinuri al Financial Times și ţine o rubrică bilunară publicată în toată lumea. Scrie zilnic pentru www.JancisRobinson.com, cu abonaţi în 100 de ţări, votat primul Wine Website of the Year la Louis Roederer International Wine Writers Awards 2010. A fost prima persoană care nu provenea din industria vinului desemnată Master of Wine, în 1984. A primit Ordinul Imperiului Britanic, în 2003, din partea reginei Elisabeta a II-a, a cărei pivniţă de vinuri o are în grijă, și a devenit ofiţer al Ordre du Mérite Agricole în 2010. Din ianuarie 2012 este președinte onorific al Wine amp; Spirit Education Trust

# World Atlas of Wine by Litera Brand (The Definitive Guide to Wines)

Whether you are a seasoned oenophile or simply beginning your journey through the world of fine wines, **Atlasul mondial al vinului** provides an unparalleled resource. This essential guide is more than just a book; it is a comprehensive exploration of global viticulture and winemaking traditions, making it an indispensable reference for any wine lover.

***

## About the World Atlas of Wine Guide

This volume features authoritative insights from industry giants dedicated to wine literature. The content draws heavily on the expertise of two legendary figures in the field: Hugh Johnson and Jancis Robinson. Purchasing this atlas means gaining access to decades of accumulated knowledge, curated by those who define the global conversation about wine.

### Expert Insights from Leading Authorities

The depth and credibility of this guide are secured by its celebrated authors:

*   **Hugh Johnson:** A pioneering voice in wine writing, Hugh Johnson's career spans over four decades, marked by bestsellers like *Wine*, *Wine Companion*, and *Pocket Wine Book*. His unique blend of serious scholarship and passion for the subject has earned him worldwide admiration. His contributions have helped shape modern wine appreciation.
*   **Jancis Robinson:** Recognized globally for her solid reputation, Jancis Robinsonâs works, including the celebrated *Oxford Companion to Wine* and *Wine Grapes*, are highly regarded reference materials. She is a respected correspondent for the Financial Times and remains at the forefront of wine journalism, advising readers with unparalleled expertise.

The combination of these authors ensures that the **World Atlas of Wine** offers both historical context and cutting-edge industry knowledge, making it the ultimate resource for understanding global wines.

## Key Features You Will Discover

*   **Comprehensive Global Coverage:** Explore wine regions from every corner of the globe, learning about unique terroir and local winemaking styles.
*   **Authoritative Depth:** Benefit from decades of research provided by some of the most recognized names in enology and viticulture.
*   **Essential Reference Tool:** Whether for academic study or personal enjoyment, this atlas serves as a definitive companion for wine enthusiasts everywhere.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this atlas suitable for beginners?**
A: Yes. While the content is deep and authoritative, the structure is designed to be comprehensive, making it an excellent resource for both newcomers seeking knowledge and experts looking for detailed reference material.

**Q: Does the book cover specific grape types?**
A: Absolutely. The volume provides extensive coverage across various grape varieties and their historical significance in global winemaking.
